notes.title: Update notes - 21st July 2024
notes.content:
* Fixed more bird issues / bird is meant for faster travel and freedom not skipping obstacles
* Fixed Golem / Island Keeper quest, rewards are now properly given and a quest skip reward is found on the same island as the golem.
* Adjusted some rates on experience gains
* More bugs fixed with floating islands

notes.title: Update notes - 11th July 2024
notes.content:
* Fixed further crashable areas.
* Added new traders on various islands.
* Added more content to the game via new islands and activities.
* Fixed some quest requirement text issues.
* Fixed the large islands Agility course

notes.title: Update notes - 30th June 2024
notes.content:
* Made movement speed on all characters faster
* Fixed a game crash on the island with a tropical floating city
* Reworked fishing to be more enjoyable

notes.title: Update notes - 23rd June 2024
notes.content:
* Hunger goes down at a much slower rate
* Food gives higher benefits (More food regen per item)
* Spoiling of produce is reduced by x3
* Food stack higher in inventory and hotbar
* Cutting trees give more logs
* Assorted bug fixes

notes.title: Update notes - 19th June 2024
notes.content:
* Added floating markers indicating above water islands for easier locating main objectives
* Updated HUD
* Added Several new locations to game
* Added multiple NPCs to these locations
* 3 New Main quests / Journal notes added
* Small optimizations for older GPUs
* Fixed Health/Stamina bar bug issues
